variables_mentioned: PSTILL2 (skill level of the primary position)

linkages: The unique individual identifier merges the administrative education registers to family background information (parental education and income) and to employment histories
Student jobs are linked to occupations through the 4-digit DISCO-08 code, and occupations to degree programs through the employment shares of graduates aged 35-53 with the same level and field

sample.universe: All individuals who start higher education in Denmark during the years 1996-2015 and by age 25
sample.unit_of_observation: Individual-year (person-year); outcomes are measured in each of the first fourteen years after exit from higher education
selection_rules: Enrolled in higher education in Denmark between 1996 and 2015
Started higher education at age 25 or younger
Only the first semi-continuous enrollment period is considered; i.e. spells of enrollment in higher education interrupted by non-enrollment spells shorter than 24 months
PhD programs are excluded (PhD students are considered university employees)
Estimates are reported separately by level of highest completed education (dropout, KVU, MVU, bachelor, master)
sample.period: Higher education entry 1996-2015; labor market outcomes up to fourteen years after exit

construction_notes: Skill content of the student job: indicator for whether the primary position requires competencies at the highest or second highest level (based on PSTILL2)

Study-relevance of an occupation: the fraction of 35-53 year old individuals with the same higher education code who are employed in that (4-digit DISCO-08) occupation, measured on all primary jobs for adults with a higher education degree aged 35-53 in Denmark in 1996-2020
Because study-relevance levels are not comparable across degree programs, the main analysis uses an indicator for an occupation with above median study-relevance within the student's degree program
Student work experience is cumulated over the enrollment spell and measured at exit from higher education, in years

Higher education programs are classified into four levels (short professional KVU, professionally-oriented bachelor's MVU, bachelor's, master's) and six fields (Humanities, Arts, Education; Life Sciences; Social Sciences; Business; Natural Sciences and Engineering; Health Sciences); dropouts from all levels are grouped
Primary field of enrollment is the field in which the student is enrolled the longest during the enrollment period
Earnings and hourly wages are reported in real 2010 DKK in Table 1 (Table 2 labels them real 2000 DKK)
60 ECTS correspond to one year of full-time study
